author: puffballstudios
title: Artist Call for Abida Comic Line Art Finishing
content:
📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢

Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2

We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel.

What you'll be working on:
○ Finishing and refining line art / inks
○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages
○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches
○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction

You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills, a solid understanding of perspective, movement, and exaggeration, with clean, confident linework. You should also be comfortable adapting to an existing visual style and maintaining consistency across characters, environments, and sequential panels.

If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for Animation
content:

author: dzinrz
title: Hiring Illustrators for Character Design and Books
content:
WE’RE HIRING ILLUSTRATORS!

Are you a skilled illustrator with a passion for creativity and storytelling? We’d love to see your work!

At The Dzinrz Illustration Studio, we bring stories to life through children’s book illustrations, character design, and a variety of creative projects.

Who can apply?
Anyone with strong illustration skills, creativity, and a passion for creating engaging artwork is welcome to apply. We value talent, creativity, and the willingness to grow!

📍 Location: Applicants from Gujrat, Pakistan, will be given priority. Remote work opportunities are also available for talented artists from other locations.

📩 How to apply:
Send your portfolio or work samples to hello@thedzinrz.com

🌐 Visit www.thedzinrz.com to explore our portfolio and get a better understanding of the projects we work on.

Know someone who loves illustration? Tag them or share this opportunity!

Let’s create something amazing together.
